title: Meeting Minutes Workbench
summary: A Cantonese transcript goes in; a minutes document in the department's exact Word format comes out. Two hours of reformatting became two minutes of waiting and three of checking.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Prompt design, JSON contract, validator, Word generator (with one teammate)

facts.label: Before → after
facts.value: 1–2 hours of fixing → 2 minutes + a 3-minute check

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: Feishu Spark / Aily · React · NestJS · jszip · docx

sections.heading: Two passes on purpose
paragraphs: The first LLM pass understands: it fixes transcription errors, cuts the meeting into the template's seven sections and marks anything it could not hear. The second writes: formal Chinese, official tone, no number touched. A script pours the result into the Word template.
sections.quote: Missing content → fix pass one. Wrong tone → fix pass two. Never start over.

sections.heading: The output is the template itself
paragraphs: Not "like" the template: the same file with the text swapped, formatting untouched. Unclear lines are flagged in place instead of guessed; date, time and venue are left for the secretary.

sections.heading: Before → after
paragraphs: Before, the transcript was pasted into a chatbot and the output never matched the template; one to two hours of fixing. Now the file is dropped in, the Word document is back in two minutes, and checking takes three.
